mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers hawkish monetary policy that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 2.0% during monetary tightening cycles increases borrowing costs and reduces liquidity, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%.
